  node_out=$(node /output/test7.mjs "$@" 2>&1); node_status=$?
  exe_out=$(/workspace/dataset/test7_executable "$@" 2>&1); exe_status=$?
  node_out=${node_out//test7.mjs/PROG}

  if [[ "$node_status" -ne "$exe_status" || "$node_out" != "$exe_out" ]]; then
    echo "FAIL: $label"
    echo "node_status=$node_status exe_status=$exe_status"
    printf "node_out=%s'"\\n\" \""'$node_out"
    printf "exe_out=%s'"\\n\" \""'$exe_out"
    fail=1
  else
    echo "PASS: $label"
  fi
}
run_case basic --a x --b y
run_case help --help
run_case missing_a --b y
run_case missing_b --a x
run_case missing_value --a x --b
run_case duplicate --a foo --a bar --b baz
run_case inline --a=foo --b=bar
run_case unknown_after_required --a x --b y --c z

run_case negative_decimal --a -.5 --b y

if [[ \""'$fail" -ne 0 ]]; then
  exit 1
fi
'"'"
